messages:
alice.nguyen: Heads-up — getting multiple requests to extend SIEM retention for audits/onboarding. We need a single source-of-truth: a retention-justification form + an RBAC onboarding checklist. Who wants to own?
ben.khan: +1. Current ad-hoc approvals are a mess, and we keep handing out broad read roles. Propose TTL options in form: 30 / 90 / 365 / archival w/justification.
carol.lewis: Also a KMS question — can we require exports (SIEM snapshots) to be encrypted with ephemeral keys that require an unwrap ticket? That would limit persistent plaintext exports.
dinesh.patel: We use ephemeral unwrap for forensics snapshots today but not for scheduled SIEM exports. Gap noted. Also need a standard audit entry template so reviewers can see "why" access was granted.
irene.cho: Legal guidance: default retention = 90 days. Exceptions need documented business justification + retention owner. If customer PD is present, default to conservative (365) unless legal approves. Use this form: https://forms.redwood.com/retention-request (internal).
sec-bot: Reminder: policy SIEM-EXPORTS-1 requires JIT RBAC for exports older than 30 days and KMS envelope-wrapping for off-platform storage. See playbook: https://intra.redwood/policies/siem-exports.
ben.khan: Suggest adding mandatory fields in form: "data categories", "business owner", "retention period", "review cadence", "approved by (legal/sec)". Also checkbox: "requires KMS ephemeral unwrap".
carol.lewis: For feasibility: can we implement a gating flow? prototype idea: export job writes encrypted blob to GCS/S3 wrapped by customer/ephemeral key + a ticket ID stored in audit log. Unwrap requires a ticket id + approver signature.
dinesh.patel: Rough RBAC command we can automate (example):
```
rbacctl grant --subject user:ben.khan --role siem_export_reader --ttl 3600 --ticket 12345
```
We wire the ticket -> approval workflow in PagerDuty or Zendesk.
ben.khan: Nice. For the audit log entries we should require a minimal JSON line like: `{"ticket":12345,"approver":"carol.lewis","reason":"regulatory audit","ttl":3600}` appended to security-audit stream.
alice.nguyen: Action items: I will draft a short retention-justification template today. @ben.khan to prototype the RBAC CLI + ticket binding. @carol.lewis to validate KMS unwrap feasibility with infra. @dinesh.patel to update incident playbook to reference the new form. @irene.cho to confirm legal wording.
irene.cho: I can review wording today afternoon. Make the exceptions flow explicit and timeboxed.
sec-bot: Logged action: created task SEC-4812 "Define retention request form + RBAC gating" assigned to alice.nguyen.
carol.lewis: One more ask — include a mandatory "purge verification" step after TTL expires (automated scrub or proof-of-delete). Can't rely on manual ops.
ben.khan: Agree. We'll add a verification webhook that posts deletion proof to security-audit.
alice.nguyen: Great. I'll post the first draft of the form here in this thread in ~4h. If anyone has compliance examples or quick templates, drop them below or DM me. :thumbsup:
